integrity: The exact value and unique center follow from a symbolic four-bound reflected-containment argument; finite rational tests corroborate rather than replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to existing nontrivial Steiner \(2\)-designs with block size at least three. Does not assert design existence, extend to arbitrary rank-three matroids, or compute Euclidean ellipsoids. Independent novelty assessment remains outstanding.
title: Steiner design base polytopes have hypersimplex asymmetry except for the Fano plane
